Dorthe Svenstrup is a lead consultant specializing in heart diseases and holds a PhD at Hospitalsenhed Midt in Denmark [^src1]. Within the national framework for atrial fibrillation treatment, she serves as a member of the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]], the steering committee responsible for overseeing the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database and its broader quality development initiatives [^src1]. 

Svenstrup is particularly noted for her leadership at the interdisciplinary [[atrieflimren-klinik|Atrieflimren-klinik]] (Atrial Fibrillation clinic) at Hospitalsenhed Midt [^src1]. Since the clinic's establishment in 2012, she has driven a central quality improvement effort by implementing structured patient education programs designed for both patients and their relatives [^src1]. Her work exemplifies the clinical goals outlined in the 2024 AFDK report, which emphasize uniform, evidence-based, and patient-centered care for individuals living with this common and potentially serious chronic heart condition [^src1].
